about: Expected values for the synthetic test documents. All amounts in rupees (integers).

conventions.metrics: Closing balances, 365-day year. EBITDA = PBT + finance cost + depreciation - other income. Debt = long-term + short-term borrowings. Inventory and payable days on cost of materials.

kestrel.name: Kestrel Forgings Private Limited
kestrel.format: xlsx, one workbook, 3 years side by side, formulas for subtotals
kestrel.story: Receivable days stretch from ~62 (FY23) to ~94 (FY25); EBITDA margin eases 20% -> 18%.

bluepeak.name: Bluepeak Polymers Limited
bluepeak.format: xlsx, one workbook per year with previous-year comparatives, values only, older wording, standalone and consolidated sheets
bluepeak.story: Debt-funded expansion: borrowings rise, EBITDA margin falls 16% -> 12% as material costs rise.
